note: P4394 (Pro 31:20) — she opens her hand to the poor and reaches out her hands to the needy.

267392.gloss: opens her hand to the poor (paras)

dims.v: generosity — the open hand and reaching arm toward the poor and needy

the opening of her hand to the poor and reaching out of her hands to the needy — the active generosity that, amid all her industry and enterprise, turns outward to give to the weak, prosperity flowing into compassion
(the poor and needy she gives to)
the open-handed compassion that shares her plenty with the weak

paras (spread/open) — 'she OPENS her hand to the poor and reaches out her hands to the needy' (31:20); her capability is not self-serving — she gives generously to the poor. Enterprise and compassion meet in her: what she gains, she shares. Emergent: open-handed generosity crowning her industry (cf 31:19; 11:24-25).
